verdicts.reason: A leaves the headline and Shop button tiny, with no shared edge or axis: the headline floats mid-left and the button sits lower and off to one side. The rest of the canvas is dead purple, so there is no hierarchy or grouping. B keeps the brand, the type sizes and the headline-to-CTA order, but it just enlarges the banner row across the middle of a 16:9 canvas instead of rearranging it, which leaves big empty bands above and below. The pill also sits close to the right edge.
